B: the pinned observation returns {}; compact JSON has L0 'Retry review', session_goal 'Review the compact retry result', completed ['captured evidence'], in_progress ['review callers']. External continuation is UNAVAILABLE and the saved handoff remains recoverable; no observation POST or state/archive mutation occurs because the required external capability was not validated.
